<thought>To fulfill the task, I will:
1. Define a list of up to 40 nitride compositions (e.g., AlN, GaN, TiN, etc.).
2. Use the **batch_retrieve_polymorphs** tool with the provided limits (max_energy_above_hull = 0.3, max_per_composition = 3) and save the results in the working directory.
3. List the generated JSON files, build a mapping from composition to its file path, and then combine them with **consolidate_polymorph_datasets** into a single JSON file.
4. Return the path to the consolidated dataset.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "AlN", "GaN", "InN", "BN", "Si3N4", "TiN", "ZrN", "HfN", "CrN", "MoN",
        "VN", "NbN", "TaN", "ScN", "YN", "Mg3N2", "Ca3N2", "Sr3N2", "Ba3N2",
        "Li3N", "Na3N", "K3N", "Be3N2", "Zn3N2", "Cd3N2", "FeN", "CoN", "NiN",
        "Cu3N", "Ag3N", "Au3N", "PtN", "PdN", "SiN", "GeN", "SnN", "PbN",
        "BiN", "SbN"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_batch_retrieve_nitride_polymorphs_trial_6"
}
</action_input>
